questions.text: Which keyword defines a function in Python?
questions.explanation: Named functions are defined with the def keyword.

questions.text: What is the type of the value 3.14?
questions.explanation: Numeric literals with a decimal point are float values.
Tuples cannot be changed after they are created.
len returns the number of items in the list, which is 3.
The // operator divides and rounds down to a whole number.

questions.text: How do you start a single-line comment?
questions.explanation: Python comments start with the # character.
Python catches exceptions with try and except blocks.

questions.text: What is the result of bool('')?
questions.explanation: Empty strings are falsy, so bool('') is False.

questions.text: Which method adds an item to the end of a list?
questions.explanation: list.append adds a single item to the end of the list.

questions.text: What does range(3) produce when converted to a list?
questions.explanation: range(3) starts at 0 and stops before 3.
